The =dark_mode= module compiles =darkreader-4.9.133.js= into =dark_mode.so= through a GResource (see =modules/dark_mode/Makefile=) and injects it only for the =dynamic= mode. Nothing in this directory is modified; gsurf's own code lives in =modules/dark_mode/js/=.

* How to update

Run these in a fresh, empty scratch directory (never inside the repository), then copy the two files in.

#+begin_src sh
ver=4.9.NNN
curl -sS https://registry.npmjs.org/darkreader | yq -p json ".versions[\"$ver\"].dist"   # note integrity + shasum
curl -sSO "https://registry.npmjs.org/darkreader/-/darkreader-$ver.tgz"
openssl dgst -sha512 -binary "darkreader-$ver.tgz" | base64 -w0   # must equal dist.integrity
mkdir x && tar -xzf "darkreader-$ver.tgz" -C x
sha256sum "darkreader-$ver.tgz" x/package/darkreader.js x/package/LICENSE
#+end_src

1. Check the licence is still MIT and the bundle is still the UMD build that defines =DarkReader.enable=, =disable=, =isEnabled= and =setFetchMethod=.
2. =git rm= the old =darkreader-<old>.js=, copy =x/package/darkreader.js= to =darkreader-<ver>.js= and =x/package/LICENSE= to =LICENSE=.
3. Update =DARKREADER_VERSION= in =modules/dark_mode/Makefile= and the =#define GSURF_DARK_MODE_DARKREADER_VERSION= in =gsurf-dark-mode-module.c=.
4. Update this file (version, date, URL, integrity, sha256 table) and the version in =docs/dark-mode.org=.
5. Run =GSURF_TEST_GUI=1 make test-gui= on both backends: =test-dark-mode-webkit= checks that Dark Reader still enables from the isolated world.
6. Commit the import on its own (=chore(dark_mode): update vendored Dark Reader to <ver>=).
